actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The package's model is the MJCF scene panda_pick_place, whose root element is '<mujoco model="panda_pick_place">'
The pick_place scene adds a target site and a pick_obj body with a freejoint and a box geom
panda.xml declares the radian angle unit, autolimits and the assets mesh directory
panda.xml sets the implicitfast integrator in its option element and states no timestep
The panda default class sets joint armature 0.1, damping 1, axis 0 0 1 and range -2.8973 to 2.8973
The panda default general actuator sets ctrlrange -2.8973 to 2.8973 and forcerange -87 to 87
The finger default class makes its joints slide with range 0 to 0.04
joint2 overrides the default joint range to -1.7628 to 1.7628
joint4 overrides the default joint range to -3.0718 to -0.0698
joint6 overrides the default joint range to -0.0175 to 3.7525
The model has eight general actuators: actuator1 to actuator7 act on joint1 to joint7, and actuator8 acts on the split tendon of the two finger joints
actuator2, actuator4 and actuator6 override the default ctrlrange with -1.7628 to 1.7628, -3.0718 to -0.0698 and -0.0175 to 3.7525
actuator8 has ctrlrange 0 to 255 on the split tendon and forcerange -100 to 100
The two finger joints are coupled by an equality constraint

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge takes no seed input and cap.world.reset.v1 zeroes the model data, so a run repeats exactly on the same engine but no seed selects a different state

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the model file for the joint dimensions, actuator count, per-actuator control ranges and time step but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts and actuator dynamics are not MuJoCo's

no mesh or texture of the asset directory is loaded and no contact, equality or tendon constraint is resolved by the stand-in; the finger equality and the split-tendon gripper of the model are not applied
the model sets no <option timestep> (panda.xml:4); the fake uses the MuJoCo library default as a placeholder, not a bound stated by the clone
the bridge reset zeroes the model data; the upstream learning environment resets to the home keyframe (panda.xml:280-281) through MuJocoRobotEnv.reset, which this package does not serve
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine
no rendering is offered and no physical Franka Panda robot is modelled; nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
